text:
Nina (People Ops): Thanks for coming to the all-hands! Quick follow-up thread for hybrid/office ops Qs — travel, offsites, desk booking, reimbursements. Drop short Qs and we'll answer live.
Samir: Do we still have the $500 per-person offsite travel stipend for small teams? :thinking:
Nina (People Ops): Yes — team offsites under 50 people: up to $500/attendee reimbursable. Please use the travel workflow in Concur and tag expenses with `OPS_OFFSITE`.
Lily: Clarify — does that cover coworking day passes if someone travels to meet a customer? Or is that different?
Nina (People Ops): Coworking day passes for customer meetings are allowed up to $50/day and should be coded as `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`. If it's just social coworking for remote work, not reimbursable.
Jordan: Any guidance for booking flex flights vs refundable? I sometimes need flexibility for family stuff.
Nina (People Ops): Book cheapest reasonable fare with flexibility only if required. If you need refundable fares for personal reasons, that portion should be personal expense. Ops will approve exceptions — add a short note when submitting.
Mateo: How do we reserve desks at SF hub next week? I tried the portal and it showed no desks available.
Nina (People Ops): We're prepping extra hot desks for the week after the all-hands. For this week, join the waitlist in the desk portal — we'll overflow to the East conference area. If you're on a dedicated seat plan reach out to me.
Samir: Is Redwood covering PCR tests / travel-related COVID tests for international offsites?
Nina (People Ops): Yes, if travel is company-requested (e.g., customer meetings or mandatory offsites). Add to Concur under `HEALTH_TRAVEL`. For voluntary trips, tests are personal.
Lily: Re: visa support for long offsites — what's the policy if someone needs a business visa for a month-long exchange?
Nina (People Ops): For stays >30 days we handle visa paperwork case-by-case. Start with a note to people-ops with dates & location; we may require immigration vendor support.
Jordan: Can managers approve last-minute travel budgets or do we need ops sign-off?
Nina (People Ops): Managers can approve up to $1k per person for ad-hoc travel; anything above needs ops sign-off. For group offsites, ops must be looped in for budget & travel vendor booking.
Mateo: Who covers coworking membership reimbursements if someone's on a permanent remote contract and needs a local hub?
Nina (People Ops): We do not cover ongoing coworking memberships except in special regional allowances (ex: APAC pilot). If approved, it'll be a monthly stipend — ops will confirm eligibility.
Samir: TL;DR for expense codes? :memo:
Nina (People Ops): Sure — quick list: `OPS_OFFSITE`, `TRAVEL_MEET_COWORK`, `HEALTH_TRAVEL`, `VISA_SUPPORT`, `REMOTE_STIPEND` — put these in the Concur notes. I'll post a small reference doc after this thread.
ops-bot: calendar: Created "Redwood All-Hands: Followups (Travel & Ops)" event and attached Nina's notes.
Lily: Thanks! Can you also confirm whether we reimburse parking at hubs? I bike but my partner drives in sometimes.
Nina (People Ops): Short answer: yes, hub parking is reimbursable if it's for a company meeting. Use `LOCAL_PARKING` code. Personal daily commute parking is not covered.
Jordan: If an employee books via an expense card, do they still need manager approval in Concur?
Nina (People Ops): Yes — all travel expenses require manager approval in Concur even if charged on a company card. Quick approvals are fine — ops will audit monthly.
Samir: Perfect. Appreciate the clarity :thumbsup:
Nina (People Ops): I'll follow up with a concise doc and a short Loom walkthrough of the Concur codes + desk portal. If you need anything urgent DM me.
Mateo: Awesome, thanks!
